Keep BRC_MESSAGE_TYPES as an alias of BRC_SUMMARY_TYPES for external callers.

tasks.description: Rewrite _write_brc_history (pipelines.py:4196-4290) to losslessly project messages: render `### [ts] {from_role} → {to_role if not all} ({type}): {subject}`, body, and a fenced yaml block with id, phase, and full metadata dict (when non-empty). tasks.description: In _write_brc_history, emit a companion .egg-state/brc-history/{identifier}-{phase}.json containing a list of msg.to_dict() for every filtered message. tasks.acceptance_criteria: JSON file is written on the PR branch alongside the .md file, round-trips through json.loads to a list of dicts matching Message.to_dict() output, and includes HANDOFF/AGENT_FAILED/OVERSEER_ALERT/STATUS/NUDGE/QUESTION messages.

tasks.description: Update existing tests (test_brc_history.py, test_pr_phase_brc_rewrite.py, test_diagnostic_logging_1633.py, test_brc_phase_propagation.py if affected) and add new tests covering: ACK artifact_references/ack_version round-trip; NACK reason/revision_count round-trip; PROPOSE commit_sha round-trip; HANDOFF/OVERSEER_ALERT included in history but excluded from summary counts; JSON companion round-trips; directed-message to_role shown/broadcast omitted; PR body summary inline final-round content; <details> wrapping older rounds; artifact links in PR body.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: `make test` passes; new tests cover each listed behavior.

pr.title: Losslessly persist BRC message context to the PR
pr.description: Rewrites the three lossy BRC renderers in orchestrator/routes/pipelines.py so the PR body and the committed `.egg-state/brc-history/*` files preserve full BRC message context — including metadata (artifact references, versions, commit SHAs, revision counts), directed-message `to_role`, and non-CONSENSUS_* BRC-adjacent message types (HANDOFF, AGENT_FAILED, OVERSEER_ALERT, STATUS, NUDGE, QUESTION). Adds a JSON companion artifact for machine consumers. Rewrites the PR-body summary to inline final-round proposal and rationale content with older rounds collapsed in `<details>`, and links to the committed artifacts. Fixes #1717.
pr.test_plan:
- Automated: `make test` — orchestrator/tests/test_brc_history.py, test_pr_phase_brc_rewrite.py, test_diagnostic_logging_1633.py (updated), test_brc_phase_propagation.py, plus new tests covering metadata round-trip, JSON companion, non-CONSENSUS type inclusion/exclusion, directed-message `to_role`, PR body inline content, `<details>` collapsing, and artifact links.
- Manual: Inspect a PR produced by a BRC pipeline — verify the BRC summary contains the final-round proposal body and rationales inline, older rounds are collapsed, artifact links render, and the committed `.egg-state/brc-history/{id}-{phase}.md` and `.json` on the branch contain the full metadata for ACKs/NACKs/PROPOSEs plus non-CONSENSUS BRC-adjacent messages.
pr.manual_steps:
Pre-merge: None — all verification is covered by automated tests and PR-body inspection.
Post-merge: None — this is a PR-rendering change. Subsequent pipeline runs automatically regenerate the improved history files and PR bodies.
